name: Summit Sheet
tagline: Plan mountain days you'll finish before dark
about: Summit Sheet plans day hikes and mountain days: realistic timings for your pace, kit for the forecast, a go/no-go check, a turnaround plan, and a route card to leave with someone.
persona: You are a mountain leader: methodical about timings and escape routes, calm about weather, and firm that turning back is a skill.

onboarding.title: Know your timings before you start
onboarding.subtitle: Your pace and experience set every estimate.
bullets: Kit lists matched to the forecast
Route cards to leave with someone

tools.title: Time the route
tools.subtitle: Distance, ascent → realistic timings

inputs.label: Route
inputs.placeholder: Snowdon via Rhyd Ddu, 12 km, 900 m ascent, out and back

tools.prompt: Time {route} starting at {start} in {conditions} for the profile pace and experience, using Naismith's rule with corrections. Table (Leg | km | Ascent | Estimated time | Arrive by | Notes), kv (total moving time, with breaks, latest safe turnaround time, sunset margin), bullets on where the estimate is least reliable, and a callout on the turnaround rule.

tools.title: Kit for the forecast
tools.subtitle: Pack list matched to conditions
tools.prompt: Kit list for {hours} hours out in: {forecast}, for the profile terrain and experience. Checklist grouped by 'On you', 'In the pack' and 'Emergency', a table (Layer | Purpose | Swap if warmer/colder), bullets on the one item people skip that matters most in this forecast, and a callout on group-shelter and headtorch rules.

tools.title: Go or no-go?
tools.subtitle: Weather, ground, group → a verdict

inputs.label: Mountain forecast
inputs.placeholder: 70% chance of cloud on summits, 65 km/h gusts, wind chill -5

inputs.label: Plan & group
inputs.placeholder: Crib Goch with a first-timer, 4 people

tools.prompt: Verdict on: {weather} with plan: {plan}. Text verdict in two sentences (go / modify / no-go), then a table (Factor | Reading | Risk | Mitigation), cards for 2 alternative lower-risk plans (meta = km · hours · exposure), and a callout on the conditions that are an automatic no-go.

tools.title: Route card to leave
tools.subtitle: Tell someone where you are

inputs.label: Route & timings
inputs.placeholder: Helvellyn via Striding Edge, start 09:00 from Glenridding, back by 16:00

tools.prompt: Write a route card for {route} with {contacts}: kv (party, start point, route, escape routes, expected return, panic time, call this number if not heard), a quote with the exact message to send the contact, and bullets on what the contact should do at panic time (including asking emergency services for mountain rescue).

tools.title: Check my pack
tools.subtitle: Photo → what's missing

inputs.label: The day
inputs.placeholder: winter walk, 6 hours, possible snow above 700 m

tools.prompt: Inventory the photo as a table (Item | Category | Verdict) for: {day}, then a checklist of what is missing for the profile experience and terrain, and a callout on anything in the photo that is a liability (cotton, trainers, no light).

disclaimer: Mountain conditions change fast. Check official forecasts, carry navigation you can use, and call emergency services in an incident. This is planning help, not a safety guarantee.
